reviews.negativeText: This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result. The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers. The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation. To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises. I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway. Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem. Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment. It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.

reviews.positiveText: I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it. The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted. I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times. Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless. Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

Los baños eran limpiados diariamente, y al menos durante la mañana se veían muy bien debido a que han sido remodelados. La ubicación es excelente si te interesan las fiestas en la zona de Kings Cross (como La Cueva, una de las principales fiestas latinas de Sydney), muchos restaurantes cerca, y está a pocos metros de la estación de tren del mismo nombre que te lleva a la ciudad o a Bondi Junction (desde donde puedes tomar buses hacia Bondi Beach). Las literas son normales, ni duras ni muy cómodas.
reviews.negativeText: Roomies muy desordenados, dejaban todo tirado. Pocos baños para la cantidad de huéspedes, aunque esperable en una casa antigua reconvertida. La cena a menudo era carente de proteína, y la zanahoria en la ensalada era literalmente incomible por ser tan dura. Vi una cucaracha muerta en el comedor secundario y, al día siguiente, otra pequeña y mojada sobre la encimera. Muchos huecos sin tapar por donde otras cucarachas podrían colarse, aunque en fin, así es Sydney. El comedor principal al parecer se limpia semanalmente, porque siempre lo vi sucio. El camino a la lavandería está muy desordenado y luce bastante mal.

reviews.title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
reviews.negativeText: Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations. There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

I asked if she could at least ask housekeeper to do my bed first, she didn’t want to help me at all. She said the check in time is 3pm. I asked at 2:45 if my room is ready and she said that the bed is ready but the room is not cleaned yet and I have to wait till 3pm. The room at 3pm was completely dirty. She was clearly lying to me all the time and the bed was done long before. There was trash on the floor and hairs in the sink. It was disgusting. The other bathroom in the hostel was also very dirty. The receptionist works online and have no idea what the housekeepers are doing, or not doing and she is not willing to help guests at all. I saw her asking someone is that person works there, how she can not know that? Also the day I was checking out, the other receptionist told me I can store my backpack till 2pm and when I asked if I can pick it up at 3pm she just repeated the same sentence. Didn’t even say that sorry it’s not possible or anything, just was repeating the same sentence as a robot. Like why I can store my backpack only till 2pm? The hostel costs 75$ a night, I should be about to at least leave my bag there when I wait for my flight. It’s ridiculous. Also to rent a towel is $15. You can definitely find a better place in this price with nice and helpful staff. There are many different hostels on this street.

Det sa att det skulle titta på rummet vilket det gjorde, personalen som kolla sa att vi hade fått fel rum och att han höll med om att det absolut inte var samma rum. De sa att vi kunde byta till det rätta rummet dagen efter men INTE få återbetalt för natten i det hemska rummet vi hade. De sa även att det inte var återbetalningsbart trots att det inte appliceras i fall där kunden har blivit SCAMMAD. Till slut går det med på att återbetala om vi lämnar SAMMA KVÄLL, klockan var 20:00 och det var otroligt påfrestande. Vi fråga om det gick bra att byta till det rätta rummet morgonen efter då vi inte kunde hitta boende. ”Kundtjänst” sa då följande: Ni har fått rätt rum, alla de privata rummet ser ut så, bilderna på Booking är bara ”refrensbilder” - trots att de hade sagt att vi fick fel rum? Vi fick tag på Booking som hjälpte oss att få full återbetalning och vi lämnade samma kväll. Kort sagt, rummen ser inte ALLS ut som de gör på bilderna och jag avråder samtliga personer från att bo här.

There’s only one women’s bathroom with 2 toilets and 2 showers—for the entire hostel! No security, no privacy. The kitchen was disgusting: dirty pots, plates, cups, everything! People leave a mess and there’s nobody to clean it up. There’s no reception—just one person online talking to you through a camera and a computer screen. The ad claims the rooms have air conditioning—total lie! The room is hot, the bed is terrible. There’s not a single common area. Just a filthy kitchen with a table and chairs, and some weird cubicle with benches. So forget trying to arrive early, relax, charge your phone, hang out, or meet anyone—impossible! Rotten place. I would never go back, I’d rather sleep in the subway. I paid way too much because they lie in their ads, while there are so many better, cheaper hostels with friendly, attentive staff. I already know hostel service in Australia can be poor, but this place took mediocrity to a whole new level. My advice? Don’t stay here—unless you want to punish yourself, or hope they either go out of business or actually improve. Total trash.
